title: Structural Designer I
note: Structural packaging design at a corrugated box plant; corrugated experience preferred, not required.

facts.summary: Entry-level structural packaging designer at International Paper's Fond du Lac box plant.
facts.duties: Create package designs, specs and prototypes for sales, propose improved designs, cut samples on the CAD table and help order print plates and dies.
facts.requirements: Associate to four-year degree with CAD/drafting emphasis or equivalent experience; Microsoft Office; corrugated experience preferred.
facts.apply: Apply through the listing's Apply Now button.
